The '''''Indulgent''-class luxury starliner''' was one of the most luxurious models of [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was manufactured by [[Leonore Luxury Liners Incorporated/Legends|Leonore Luxury Liners Incorporated]].<ref name="Far Horizons" />
